description: Fetch UK legislation data from legislation.gov.uk including act details,  index listings by type/year, Atom feeds, and XML data exports.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_legislation: Get details of a specific legislation item (act, regulation, etc.); 参数: url, legislation_type, year, chapter; 必填: url
  - get_index: Get list of legislation for a type and year/range; 参数: legislation_type, year; 必填: year
  - get_feed: Get Atom feed for legislation list (structured XML data); 参数: url, legislation_type, year, page; 必填: url
  - get_xml: Get XML data for a specific legislation item; 参数: url, legislation_type, year, chapter; 必填: url
  - search: Search legislation by query, title, year, type; 参数: query, title, year, type, page; 必填: 无

url.description:
Full URL or path to legislation. Used by get_legislation, get_feed, get_xml.
Examples: /ukpga/Geo6/14-15/27, /ukla/1951/data.feed

legislation_type.description:
Legislation type code. Used by get_legislation, get_index, get_feed, get_xml, search.
Common values: ukpga (UK Public General Acts), ukla (UK Local Acts), 
asp (Acts of Scottish Parliament), mwa (Acts of Senedd Cymru),
uksi (UK Statutory Instruments), nisr (Northern Ireland Statutory Rules)

year.description:
Year or year range. Used by get_legislation, get_index, get_feed, get_xml, search.
Examples: 2023, 1950-1959, Geo6 (regnal year)

chapter.description:
Chapter or number. Used by get_legislation, get_xml.
Examples: 27, 1, c.1

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Used by get_feed, search.

query.description: Search query text. Used by search.

title.description: Filter by title. Used by search.

type.description: Filter by legislation type. Used by search.
